tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders are requested to go through the bid document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be a regular Contractor/Agency/Firm and shall have proven experience in Providing Service of driver/vehicle to utility services/any Govt. departments / undertaking / institutions or public sectors (undertaking) relevant documents shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relenvant document shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder in name should have satisfactorily executed similar service of worth Rs 7.47 lakhs in single work order in any of preceding five financial years (i.e 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26) The bidder shall furnish the relevant work order and work done certificate. Work done of previous years shall be given weight of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the present price level of the financial year in which the tender are invited

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Reevant Work order and Work Done Certificate

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder in his name should have achieved an average annual financial turnover of Rs 15.74 lakhs in last two years preceding five financial years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26) as a proof of this, the bidder shall furnished the certified copy of profit and loss account statement or turnover certificate duly certified the chartered accountant. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weight of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year in which the tender are invited

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Audited CA Certificate Annual Turnover
